scope: backend implementability, revision §§7-12, consistency with docs/41 catalog protocol

prior_findings.evidence: §§2.1 and 7 now require 16-byte/128-bit ID encoded as 32 lowercase hex, matching docs/41 §109.1.
§9 specifies TryLock polling, context/deadline and post-acquisition cancellation/uncertainty semantics.
§§3 and 9 assign shared and per-case resources, leases, close order and partial-close ownership.
§9 specifies glebarez/modernc URI, mode=rw, single connection, forbidden options and trusted-directory limitation.

findings.title: Close method signatures cannot express specified context timeout
findings.detail: Both Close APIs are declared without context in §3, while §9 requires context-governed draining, close_pending on timeout and retry by the owner.
findings.required_action: Use Close(ctx context.Context) or define a coherent bounded context-free close contract and update both sections.

findings.title: Stable error taxonomy is inconsistent across sections
findings.detail: Section 3 enumerates five stable errors, while later sections introduce lock_timeout, close_pending, recovery_integrity_error and cleanup_pending.
findings.required_action: Define one complete error enum with retryability and poisoning semantics, then reference it throughout.
